easyPrerequisites: Striking Palette must have valid targets.
description:
Cast Striking Palette using the convoke ability from Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Pigment Wrangler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pigment Wrangler, which enters prepared.
Resolve Striking Palette.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
